system.notes:
A mini-grenade for a grenade launcher (SR3 p.283): the Defensive AP Grenade's effects, fired rather than thrown. It does not arm until it has travelled about five metres (SR3 p.118).

AP grenades are offensive or defensive grenades with high fragmentation; they are specifically designed to damage unarmored people. Determine damage from AP grenades according to the flechette rules (SR3 p.116, p.119).

SR3 p.283, the Mini-grenade row applied to the Defensive AP Grenade row: Conceal 8, Weight .1, Availability 4/4 days +2, Cost 30¥ ×2, Street Index 2 +1. Legality 3-J. Blast –1/.5m.
